title: Study of Synovial Lactate Level as Marker of Septic Arthritis
brief_summary: Lactate levels are rapidly available and may potentially aid in diagnosing septic arthritis in a native joint. This study will determine the utility of synovial lactate in discriminating septic from aseptic arthritis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Age 21 and older
* Suspected infected joint

Exclusion criteria:

* Age under 21
* Prosthetic joint affected
* Overlying cellulitis
study_population: Patients 21 years or older with tender swollen joints undergoing arthrocentesis will be enrolled in the study. Exclusion criteria will be overlying cellulitis, affected prosthetic joints and age under 21.
